contradictions.fact: Luna Camp vs Luna Col (high camp)

claims.says: Day 1: Water taxi from Ross Dam to Big Beaver, hike 9.4 miles to Luna Camp (7,200 ft)
0600 from Luna Camp
Luna Camp, Big Beaver Trail — elev 2432
Luna Col bivy — elev 7200
back to Luna Camp and Luna Col

contradictions.why: The itinerary puts Luna Camp at 7,200 ft and starts summit day from it, but Luna Camp is the 2,432 ft trail camp; the 7,200 ft high camp is Luna Col.
contradictions.internal_resolution: The bivy cards and waypoints separate Luna Camp (2,432 ft, on the trail) from Luna Col (7,200 ft); the itinerary and timing mix them up.
